children: TTM Technologies reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.204B, up 59.9% from $752.7M a year earlier. Net income rose 59.8% to $84.8M, while diluted EPS increased 58% to $0.79, supported by higher sales volume and favorable product mix.
Revenue was $1.204B, compared with $752.7M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 59.9%.
Net income was $84.8M, compared with $53.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 59.8%.
Diluted EPS was $0.79, compared with $0.50 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 58%.
Data center and networking accounted for 41% of quarterly sales, up from 30%; aerospace and defense represented 34%.
Commercial sales grew 92.7% and aerospace and defense sales rose 20.9%. Both segments improved operating margins on stronger volume and mix.
TTM completed its STG acquisition in September, expanding its European PCB, microcircuit and medical-technology capabilities. Epiq was acquired after quarter-end.
The company raised its 2026 capital spending plans and announced an additional $400M capacity expansion to support AI-infrastructure demand.
